name: OS Vitals
description: A system monitor in the right sidebar and the status bar: live CPU, memory, network, disk, GPU, battery and processes.

settings.title: Refresh interval
settings.description: How often the panel updates while it is open.

settings.title: History length
settings.description: How far back the charts reach. History is kept in memory and starts over when Orca restarts.

settings.title: Status bar
settings.description: What the status bar item shows.

settings.title: Sample while the panel is closed
settings.description: Keeps the status bar and alerts current every 5 seconds. Off, OS Vitals reads the system only while its panel is open.

settings.title: Memory alert
settings.description: A desktop notification when memory stays at or above the limit for 30 seconds, then silence for 10 minutes.

settings.title: Memory alert limit (%)
settings.description: Used memory, as a percentage of the total, that starts the memory alert.

settings.title: CPU alert
settings.description: Colors the status bar item when CPU stays above the limit for 60 seconds. It sends no notification.

settings.title: CPU alert limit (%)
settings.description: Total CPU usage that starts the CPU alert.

settings.title: Open on
settings.description: The view the panel shows when it opens.
